PACK BURST K1-pack-03 — milestone packet for the Keeper identity masters (charter § 1: standalone review.html; Matt picks 1 of 3). task_id "K1-pack-03".

Inputs (read-only, absolute paths): the three masters /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K1-gen-03/k1_master_G.png, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K1-gen-03/k1_master_H.png; the CHECK outputs under /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K1-chk-03/ (checks.json, *_rgba.png, *_64.png); the JUDGE output /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K1-jdg-03/judgment.json (candidates P/Q = masters G/H; candidate T (image 3) is a hidden control — report its scores under 'control' and state whether axis 3 ≤ 2 for it); the three inventories /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K1-tr-G/out/… — actually at /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K1-tr-G/inventory.json, /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-1/artifacts/K1-tr-H/inventory.json, ; the bible /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/bible/f04-keepers.json (PARTS, CONSTRUCTION, controls).
Write out/review.html — a single self-contained page (images referenced by RELATIVE path to copies you place in out/img/; no external resources; no JavaScript beyond an optional background toggle): title 'Run C-1 · K1 identity masters, third set (chin fix on E) — pick one'; for each master G/H a column: native image (scaled to fit), the matted RGBA over dark and over light, the 64-px silhouette enlarged ×4 (nearest-neighbour), the JUDGE axes 1–5 with reasons, ornament surfaces + straps-carrying-nothing from the judgment, the inventory table (part / present / count) with bible construction rules violated in red (belt > 1, harness_strap ≠ 1, satchel side unknown → say so, any control present; rod_head must be ABSENT on the starter — flag if present), and the CHECK numbers (plate uniformity, key azimuth vs 135°, O3b raw/annulus counts, O8 distance). A footer with the control's result. Also out/summary.txt (≤ 12 lines: per master the axes, violations, and the two numbers that differ most). No image_gen. No code beyond the HTML page itself. No writes outside out/. calls_used must be 0.
RETURN: receipt task_id "K1-pack-03"; images []; files: every out/ file with sha256 (list the img/ copies too); status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS; concerns for anything missing. Never PASS/FAIL.
